title: QUIC Major Peer Interop Matrix Verification
verification_method: Workflow review, requirement-home tests, helper dry-run plans, hosted workflow dispatch, artifact inspection, and SpecTrace validation.
preconditions: The external `quic-interop-runner` checkout includes `quic-go` and `msquic` peer slots.
Hosted dispatch has Docker Engine 28.1 or later, Python 3.12, and Wireshark packet-analysis tools available.

The repo-local helper remains responsible for image replacement, runner invocation, inventory output, and per-cell artifact capture that feed the generated `interop-major-peer-matrix-inventory` and `interop-major-peer-matrix-evidence-25904716076` reports.
scope: Verify that the repository exposes a manual advisory profile for role-backed major non-HTTP/3 interop evidence against `quic-go` and `msquic`, without promoting blocked cells or changing ordinary CI gates, and that the generated inventory/evidence reports stay aligned with that workflow shape.
procedure: Review `.github/workflows/interop-runner-handshake.yml` and confirm the `major-peer-matrix` profile is `workflow_dispatch` only.
Confirm the profile includes local client and local server matrix cells against `quic-go` and `msquic` for `handshake`, `retry`, `transfer`, `keyupdate`, and `resumption`.
Confirm `http3`, `zerortt`, `chacha20`, `versionnegotiation`, `v2`, `rebind-port`, `rebind-addr`, `connectionmigration`, and `post-handshake-stream` are not part of the major peer matrix.
Confirm every matrix cell invokes `scripts/interop/Invoke-QuicInteropRunner.ps1` with matrix-provided role, local implementation slot, peer slot, testcase, timeout, and artifact root.
Confirm each cell uploads a distinct artifact bundle with `if: always()`.

Run helper failure-summary tests that prove `keyupdate` and `resumption` FileNotFound advisory downgrades require testcase-specific preserved-log markers and still fail when those markers are incomplete.
Run the focused requirement-home tests for `REQ-QUIC-INT-0017` and `REQ-QUIC-INT-0019`.
Run representative helper dry-run plans for quic-go and msquic client/server cells.
Inspect the generated advisory `interop-major-peer-matrix-inventory` and `interop-major-peer-matrix-evidence-25904716076` reports for the same cell set.

When external evidence is required, dispatch `gh workflow run interop-runner-handshake.yml --repo incursa/quic-dotnet --ref main -f coverage_profile=major-peer-matrix` and inspect each uploaded `runner-report.json` plus selected output logs.
expected_result: The repository configuration provides an opt-in major peer matrix that can collect per-cell artifacts for Incursa.Quic as client and server against quic-go and msquic for the currently executable major non-HTTP/3 scenarios, while keeping blocked cells and HTTP/3 out of scope, and the generated inventory/evidence reports remain the advisory record of those runs.
status_summary: Planned for hosted execution. The repository now has the manual major peer matrix profile and local workflow-shape proof. Passing focused tests and representative helper dry-runs prove the configuration shape; hosted per-cell runner artifacts are still required before claiming the major peer matrix itself is green. The generated `interop-major-peer-matrix-inventory` and `interop-major-peer-matrix-evidence-25904716076` reports already preserve the latest advisory evidence. The latest local server-role msquic reruns still fail with TLS alert 50 and remain explicit blocked evidence rather than green, which keeps the matrix honest until the upstream qns trust/config gap is resolved. Full SpecTrace core validation remains blocked by the current RFC9000 JSON parse/reference cascade and is not claimed as passing by this artifact.

supplemental_sections.heading: Deferred Coverage
supplemental_sections.content: `http3` remains out of scope. `v2`, `rebind-port`, `rebind-addr`, and `connectionmigration` are supported/executed inventory cells, but they remain outside this role-backed profile by scope. `versionnegotiation` now has explicit harness dispatch, but it remains outside this role-backed profile by scope. The generated major-peer inventory and evidence reports stay advisory and are not support proof.
